description:
Bring octo_pi_tui to rough feature parity with the upstream pi-mono interactive TUI.

Current state: ~5k LOC, basic infrastructure (terminal, stdin_fsm, key_parser, renderer, overlay, input, select_list, footer, text). Interactive mode handles streaming text only — no tool display, no markdown, no dialogs, no themes, no autocomplete, no extension integration. Footer and overlay are built but not wired into the render pipeline.

Target: a TUI that looks and feels like pi-mono's interactive mode — markdown-rendered messages, tool execution display, model/session selectors, autocomplete, theme support, and extension hooks.

Upstream reference: tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/ + tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/

Organized into tiers:
- T1: Foundation (theme, container, footer wiring)
- T2: Content rendering (markdown, message components, tool execution)
- T3: Editor & autocomplete
- T4: Dialogs & selectors
- T5: Extension integration
- T6: Terminal features & polish
title: Phase 4.1: TUI feature parity with pi-mono
